name: IPS Packaging & Automation
old_description: From materials to automation, IPS delivers reliable packaging solutions backed by nationwide distribution and experts who understand your operation.
about:
IPS Packaging & Automation is headquartered in Orangeburg, South Carolina, and has operated since its founding in 1976. The company is certified as a service‑disabled veteran‑owned business and has built a nationwide distribution network over nearly five decades. While the founders are not named in public materials, the business began as a packaging supplier and expanded into automation and engineering services.

The firm supplies industrial packaging materials — boxes, bubble wrap, tape, mailers, and void‑fill systems — and provides packaging equipment, end‑of‑line automation, conveyor integration, robotic palletizing, and custom engineering and kitting services. Its nationwide network enables distribution from multiple locations, though specific facility sizes and headcount are not disclosed.

IPS serves a broad range of sectors including aerospace, automotive, food and beverage, medical, electronics, e‑commerce fulfillment, chemicals, construction, and transportation. The company highlights sustainable packaging options such as recyclable kraft paper and responsibly sourced protective materials for customers aiming to reduce waste.

The company emphasizes its veteran‑owned status, ISO 9001:2015 certification, and a culture of continuous improvement and knowledge sharing as differentiators. It positions its expertise as U.S.-based and focused on tailoring solutions to each operation’s throughput and labor‑reduction goals.
